Olise struck again, curling in a free-kick before Alessandro Bastoni landed a deserved equaliser for Azzurri.

At the moment, Zinedine Zidane's side lead the group with seven points. France will be missing Dayot Upamecano, who is suspended after a second straight yellow against Italy.
